summary: Iteration 4 backend-only testing of BarterGrid against the public URL (https://trade-network-27.preview.emergentagent.com/api). Added a new 39-test suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py covering: guest/public browsing (GET /listings, /community/stats, /users/{id} all 200 without a token, ?mine=true still 401), public storefront payload (contains listings[], leaks no email/approx_lat/approx_lng/password_hash/_id), all 11 new storefront+payment PATCH /profile fields (persisted and re-read via /auth/me, plus accepts_donations=false round-trip), direct messaging (symmetric+idempotent conversation id, message persistence, last_message/last_message_at update, recipient notification with conversation_with, direct_message email queued, per-conversation unread that clears after opening the thread, third-party isolation of the A-B thread, self-DM 400, 401 without auth, block enforcement 403 in BOTH directions + restored after unblock), trade lifecycle notifications (propose/accept/decline/meetup/one-sided-complete texts and rating_request to BOTH users on completion), referral system (referrals/mine shape, PII-free referred_users, public referrals/lookup/{code} incl. lowercase code, 404 for bad code, verified_referral=true for BOTH referee and referrer after the referee's first completed trade with referral_verified notifications for both, bogus referral code at signup is ignored gracefully), AI POST /ai/suggest-category (returned real category 'Tools' for 'Cordless drill and battery' via gpt-5.4 - no fallback needed; 401 without auth), db.email_queue kinds (trade_proposal, direct_message, meetup_planned, trade_update all present with correct doc shape/status=pending), and MongoDB index verification on users/listings/trades/trade_messages/notifications/blocks/conversations/dm_messages incl. unique-flag checks. Backward-compat: existing /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py passes 29/29 after updating ONE now-obsolete test (it asserted GET /listings unauthenticated == 401, which contradicts the new guest-browsing contract; rewritten to assert 200 + ?mine=true 401). Combined result: 67 passed / 1 failed (68 tests). Backend logs clean - zero tracebacks or 500s.

minor.issue: FAILING TEST: does not verify the recipient exists. POSTing to a nonexistent user_id returns 200 and creates an orphan conversation + dm_message + notification row for a user that does not exist. GET /api/conversations/{id} correctly 404s, so the two endpoints are inconsistent. Add the same `db.users.find_one` existence check to send_dm.

DMSendIn.to_user_id is REQUIRED (omitting it -> 422) but is completely ignored by the handler, which uses the path param. Sending a mismatched body to_user_id returns 200 and delivers to the path user. Make it optional or validate that it equals the path param.
Empty text ('') is accepted (200) and stored, blanking conversation.last_message. Add min_length=1 to DMSendIn.text (same for TradeMessageIn.text).

Leaks referral_code, referred_by, role and email_verified to unauthenticated callers. referral_code is effectively a private invite credential - anyone can scrape codes and spoof/attribute invites. Project it out (or whitelist public fields).

On FINAL completion (both parties done) notif_text stays None so NO trade_update email is queued and no 'trade completed' notification is created - only rating_request. The trade_update email only appears on the first one-sided complete. Queue a trade_completed email in the both-done branch.

DM notifications and trade-chat notifications share type='message', differing only by the presence of conversation_with vs trade_id. Frontend must branch on those extra keys; consider type='dm' for DMs.
Carried over from iterations 2-3: 403 for unknown trade_id on /messages (should be 404) and bare HTTPException(403)/(404) with no detail string at server.py:682, 748, 750, 790.

action_items: Add recipient-existence validation (404) to POST /api/conversations/{other_user_id}/messages - this is the only failing test.
Make DMSendIn.to_user_id optional (or validate against the path param) and enforce non-empty text.
Stop exposing referral_code / referred_by / role on the public GET /api/users/{id} response.
Queue a trade_update/trade_completed email (and optionally a 'trade completed' notification) in the both-sides-complete branch of trade_action.
Split server.py (1091 lines) into routers: auth/profile, listings/matching, trades, dms, referrals, admin.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1091 lines - over the 700-line guideline; split into APIRouter modules.
db.email_queue has no indexes and no consumer; queue rows accumulate forever (36 rows already). Add an index on (status, created_at) and a TTL/cleanup plan.

_conv_id_for builds the conversation_id by concatenating both raw user_ids ('conv_<a>_<b>'), so the id itself discloses the counterparty id if ever logged/shared. Functionally fine (unique index present) but consider a hashed id.
list_conversations and list_listings run an N+1 user/blocks lookup per document; fine at current scale, will need $lookup aggregation later.

trade_action 'cancel'/'complete' are still unguarded by status (a declined or already-completed trade can be re-cancelled or re-completed, which can double-increment successful_trades). Still open from iteration 3.
ProfileUpdate still strips None, so store_tagline/banner_photo/payment handles cannot be CLEARED with null (empty string works) - worth documenting for the frontend.

No format validation on payment handles (cashapp_tag, paypal_link, bitcoin_address, etc.) - arbitrary strings are rendered on a public storefront; add light regex/URL validation to reduce scam/XSS-vector surface.
seed_data_creation: Per-run ephemeral users TEST_i4alice/i4bob/i4carol/i4dave/i4erin/i4frank (password Passw0rd!23) with listings Solar Lantern/Camp Stove/Hand Saw/Axe Head (listings deleted on teardown). Two completed trades, DM conversations and email_queue rows persist per run (harmless, only affects aggregate stats). Manually cleaned the orphan conversations/messages/notifications created for user_nope123 by the failing DM test.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md - self-registration via POST /api/auth/signup, password Passw0rd!23. No pre-seeded accounts; admin console endpoints (/api/admin/*) were NOT exercised because no admin user is seeded (get_admin requires role=='admin').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v. Two suites: backend_test.py (29 legacy tests, all green; test_unauthenticated_listings_401 was renamed to test_unauthenticated_listings_public for the new guest-browsing contract) and test_iteration4.py (39 tests, 38 green). The single intentional failure test_dm_unknown_user documents the real defect that send_dm does not validate the recipient exists - delete/relax it only after the backend adds the 404. test_iteration4.py talks to Mongo directly via pymongo (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env) to assert email_queue kinds and index definitions. NOT covered yet: /api/admin/* (needs a seeded admin), /api/upload + /api/files/{id} (object storage), /api/reports, Google OAuth session flow, needs-board urgency filtering, and the ENTIRE frontend UI (never tested in iterations 1-4 - biggest gap).
rca_of_the_issue: send_dm (server.py:968) checks self-DM and blocks but, unlike get_or_create_conversation (server.py:945), never looks up the target user, so an upsert on db.conversations plus a dm_messages/notifications insert happen for any arbitrary path value - producing orphan rows keyed to a nonexistent user_id. Reproduce: POST /api/conversations/user_nope123/messages with {"to_user_id":"user_nope123","text":"ghost"} using any valid token -> 200. Fix: add `if not await db.users.find_one({'user_id': other_user_id}): raise HTTPException(404, 'User not found')` before the conversation upsert.
